messages:
Anna C.: Hey team — we need to lock in a time and facilitator for the post-incident review from today (INC-2026-103). Impacted customers: ACME Corp (partial API failures), several internal dashboards. Suggest options: Thu 10:00 PT or Fri 09:00 PT. Who can facilitate? Also we should confirm attendees (oncall, infra lead, SRE, support/CS) and who will own the action-items/JIRA.
Jamal R.: I can facilitate Friday 09:00 PT if that works. Can prep a short timeline + RCA outline beforehand. :handshake:
Priya S.: Friday works for me. Can someone drop the timeline + relevant logs into the thread as pre-read? I want to pull a small eval harness to check model-serving latencies tied to the spike.
Luis M.: I'll export the runtime traces and prefix-cache metrics. Will add a short note on the autoscaler behavior. Expect that in this thread in ~30m. Code snippet for the export command for folks who want to reproduce:
```
# grab KV cache and batching histogram for the window
redwood-cli trace export --incident INC-2026-103 --from "2026-03-12T13:45:00Z" --to "2026-03-12T14:20:00Z" --tags kv-cache,batching
```
Kenji: Heads up — I'm oncall until 08:30 PT Friday, so I can do a quick handoff into the meeting and walk through mitigations. But I can't own long-term remediation items after that shift. Recommend we assign remediation to infra owners (Luis) and product (Anna).
Emma: I'll invite CS and the ACME account lead to the review so we can show timelines and communicate remediation plan. They asked for a short executive summary up front.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-103 created by pagerduty-bot. Pages: 13:04 UTC. Severity: Sev2. Current status: mitigated. Consolidated alerts: 14 alerts (network, runtime memory pressure, autoscaler thrash). Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-103
pagerduty-bot: On-call change: Kenji is primary until 2026-03-13T15:30:00Z. Next on-call: Jamal R. from 2026-03-13T15:30:00Z.
Anna C.: Thanks — plan: Jamal will facilitate Fri 09:00 PT. Agenda below. Luis + Kenji to present technical timeline. Emma will coordinate customer invite and exec summary. Priya will validate perf/eval snippets. I'll own communications and closure.
Agenda (30m):
- 5m: Quick summary & customer scope (Anna)
- 10m: Timeline + root-cause hypotheses (Kenji + Luis)
- 8m: Actions & ownership (Jamal)
- 5m: Communications & next-steps (Emma)
Priya S.: Can we add a quick pre-read package? Small checklist: incident timeline (one page), trace export link, latest canary config, and any recent deploys. Prefer a doc in the incident folder.
Jamal R.: I'll create the calendar invite and attach a PRD-style one-pager. Also will spin up a short meeting template with roles: facilitator (me), scribe (Priya?), timekeeper (Kenji), action-tracker (Anna).
Luis M.: Assigning rough follow-ups during the meeting:
- ACTION 1: Investigate autoscaler instability and suggest guardrails (owner: Luis) — due 1w
- ACTION 2: Add KV-cache metrics to alerting and dashboard (owner: Priya) — due 3d
- ACTION 3: Clarify deploy gating for heavy token loads (owner: Anna/Product) — due 2w
- ACTION 4: Customer-facing timeline & apology note (owner: Emma/CS) — due 1d
Anna C.: Please create JIRA tickets for the actions and drop IDs here before the meeting. We'll mark anything high-risk for a follow-up working session.
Kenji: Quick note about mitigations — the temporary mitigation was to reduce batching window which reduced tail latency but increased token cost. We should capture the trade-off in the postmortem so leadership sees the cost/latency decision.
Emma: ACME asked for an optional customer-facing technical appendix. I'll draft and share in the calendar invite. :memo:
incident-bot: Reminder: post-incident review scheduled by Jamal R. — pending calendar invite. Please ensure pre-reads are uploaded to https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-103
Jamal R.: Invite sent — Fri 2026-03-14 09:00 PT (link in invite). Final attendee list: Anna C., Jamal R., Priya S., Luis M., Kenji, Emma, ACME rep (optional). Meeting doc + pre-reads uploaded. Scribe = Priya.
Priya S.: Confirmed. I'll take notes and create JIRA subtasks during the meeting. Anyone who can't make it please send a delegate or add notes to the doc beforehand.
Anna C.: Thanks all. ACTIONS before the meeting: Luis to upload traces, Priya to prepare perf checks, Emma to invite CS + ACME rep, Jamal to finalize agenda & invite. We'll run the review dry-run 10m before start if needed. :white_check_mark:
Kenji: ack. See you Friday.
Emma: added ACME rep and CS lead to the invite. Also added exec summary to the calendar description.
Jamal R.: Closing thread — meeting confirmed, facilitator assigned, attendees locked, pre-reads uploaded. I'll post the postmortem draft within 48h after the review.
